reviewer: Codex /root; same-context mathematical self-review, not independent human or theorem review
conditional_scope: Formula/specification review only; no empirical assumption, originality, GPU interface or efficacy verified.

formal_object.rationale: Native predicted mesh Y_t; model/geometry-derived rotations R_t in SO(3), translations c_t; anchor X; body-frame residual u_t=R_t^T(Y_t-c_t)-X. The stated object/domain, rather than the official unsquared Chamfer, is the object of this conditional derivation.

operations_and_conditions.rationale: H01: Rigid motion gauge -> Factor out rigid motion before smoothing; condition: R_t,c_t are estimated from permitted inputs and geometry; A06: World coordinates to body-frame residuals -> Temporal repair acts on deformation, not pose; condition: Rotations are orthogonal; transform is invertible at fixed R,c All current edges remain conditional where model/data availability is not established.

derivation.rationale: At fixed orthogonal R_t and c_t, the body transform is invertible. Exact rigid animation gives zero residual, so a zero-preserving repair retains its pose for arbitrary time-varying R_t. The witness assumes exact factors and establishes no quality of fitted pose or articulated decomposition.

assumptions.rationale: Conditional validity requires: Rigid factors may be wrong or insufficient for articulated objects.; Factor estimation and downstream repair share the same tuning/cost budget as controls.; Differentiating through refitted R,c defines a different algorithm; the present subproblem freezes them.; No GT pose, cameras or evaluation ICP transforms enter inference. These are obligations, not observations about ActionBench.

method_expression.rationale: Fit a legal rigid/body-frame decomposition, temporally repair only u, and reconstruct using the unchanged estimated pose. The reviewed construction is Time filtering after factoring pose, not spatial rotation synchronization.. This is a specification, not an implemented method.

prediction_and_falsifier.rationale: The construction predicts: Pure rigid rotation/translation should be preserved by construction; improvement versus world smoothing should depend on pose variation rather than merely noise magnitude. It can be rejected by: Reject if inferred rigid factors are unstable or a equal-cost rigid-aligned Gaussian baseline gives the same native performance. This contrast is specified before any new-method experiment.

closest_alternative.rationale: Named alternatives: Classical corotational deformation and pose-factored smoothing; STAC local rigid fitting; SFG root-space local/global decomposition. Treat basic pose factoring as a strong simple baseline, not a new contribution. Claimed operational difference: An invariance-preserving coordinate choice; a basic rigid-aligned smoother may already close the gap. This check verifies an explicit comparator and conditional delta, not completed novelty clearance.
